subject: Inquiry Regarding RA/TA Assistantship Opportunities - XXXXXXX
template:
Dear Professor {last_name},

My name is [Your Full Name], and I am a graduate student in [Your Program] at [Your University]. I am writing to inquire about any available Research Assistantship (RA) or Teaching Assistantship (TA) positions in your group.

I have hands-on experience in [Your Skills], and I am eager to contribute to meaningful research while further developing my academic skills. I am particularly interested in your research work, and believe my background aligns well with your work.

If there are currently no open positions, I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to an ongoing project on a volunteer basis so you can evaluate my skills and determine whether I might be a good fit for a future assistantship role.

I have attached my resume for your reference and would be happy to discuss any openings at your convenience.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Program] | [Your University]
[Your Email]
